QuestInfo.name: Keol's Order #11
QuestInfo.0: Keol, the pompous working partner of Moren who is as irritable as they come in all of Maple, is giving me a new work request. Better go see what it is.
QuestInfo.1: Moren's coworker Keol received a request from Chil Sung and Chil Nam of Korean Folk Town to make a rake, and asked if I could make one for them.\n\n#i4001184# #t4001184# #b#c4001184# / 2
QuestInfo.2: I built a sturdy, easy-to-use rake for the delightful brothers Chil Nam and Chil Sung of Korean Folk Town. It seems like even Keol is letting up just a little bit.

0.0: We have a new order. This time, it's from Korean Folk Town... the brothers Chil Sung and Chil Nam. They requested #b2 #t4001184#s#k to be used for farming. This is easy for you, right? Right?

yes.0: Remember, we're talking about farming tools here, so they have to be durable, first and foremost. If it breaks easily, it's a death knell on our company. Our reputation will be irreparably ruined.

no.0: That's unfortunate, that you feel that it was too much for you. I didn't think that. There's nothing worse than an item-producer who lacks confidence. Nothing worse.

1.0: Is this sturdy? Are you sure you reinforced it with Mithril Anvil? Well, it does look okay for now. Pray that they don't break within a year.

item.0: I only asked for 2, but you seem to be just taking your time. I said #b2 #t4001184#s#k. Did you get what I was saying?

lost.0: This is preposterous. Unbelievable. How can you not even take care of the purchase order I gave you? What was Moren thinking? Seriously, un-be-lieeevable.
